names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Μελάσιππος, Κασσίνη και Αντώνιος και Σαράντα Παίδες», with the rank word left off. The page's own heading for them is «Αγιοι Σαραντα Παιδες».

death.note: They believed at the deliverance of Antonius from the oven and were beheaded on the spot, in the same hour, as the saint.gr page this folder already cites tells it; `antonius-son-of-melasippus`, `melasippus` and `cassine` are all recorded here as 361 or 363, and the interval is copied from them. The page gives the forty no year of their own, and names not one of them.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Μελάσιππος, Κασσίνη και Αντώνιος και Σαράντα Παίδες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page names not one of the forty and gives them no year of their own — only the three it keeps with them carry «(; - 361)» — so this is one entry and not forty, and no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
